params.prompt: Modify only Astrid's right arm/hand and the small natural forward lean needed to reach. Keep the exact existing face-up queen of spades in its CURRENT position and perspective at the centre player position below the gold arc. Show the final instant of a dealer's supported card slide: her RIGHT arm (originating viewer LEFT shoulder) extends forward across the felt, and the pads of her right index and middle fingertips REST DIRECTLY ON THE REAR EDGE of that exact queen card, still physically touching and pushing it. Wrist naturally aligned, fingers separate and anatomically correct, palm just above the felt. Her left hand remains empty beside the shoe outlet in its existing position. Her gaze follows the fingertips down. The card must NOT move closer to her body; her arm reaches the card's existing foreground location. Preserve Astrid's exact identity, hair, clothes, normal body proportions, table, shoe position, room, lighting and locked camera. Only one card. No floating gap between fingertips and card, no oversized card or extra limb. This is the contact-at-landing frame BEFORE releasing and returning the hand.

Do not call job_display, show_generations, or show_generation_by_ids to display these jobs again, either before or after completion, unless the user explicitly requests a separate display. If you need to await completion, use jobs_wait with timeout_seconds <= 15. Use job_display only if the user explicitly requests a separate re-display of one specific job.

Note: adjustments applied — medias[0].role: "image" → "image_references" (GPT Image 2.5 backend expects schema-key media roles).
